answer: A mechanism that actually bites: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because oasis only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, ledge is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any reef approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
